newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar soars on fund buying, stops hit.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar soars on fund buying, stops hit.

text.p: CSCE world sugar prices surged to their highest level in a week late Friday, led by heavy buying on the part of commodity funds, traders said.
In what was mainly a technically driven rally, steady shortcovering on the nearby switch swept the July contract through resistance at 11.00 cents a lb.

"There was very good May-July buying, and once July got above 11 cents, the funds went ballastic," a trader said. July sugar climbed to a peak of 11.18 cents, a peak from early last week, before producer selling slowed the momentum.
At 1255 EDT, July sugar was up 0.23 cent at 11.11 cents, with spot May 0.32 cent higher at 11.28 cents.
Volume was heavy at an estimate 23,093 lots as of noon.
((-- W Pollack, New York Commodities Desk +1 212 859 1640))
